This plot is not mine — I rent it, so I try not to spend too much on it because I don't know if I will farm it again next year. Still, I need a good harvest to pay back the rent and feed my family, so I will put some fertilizer, but only a small amount that I can afford. I will use the seeds I saved from last year because improved seeds from the agro-dealer are costly and sometimes hard to find here. My children and I will do most of the work, but for clearing and weeding I will hire a few young men because the plot is almost one hectare and my back cannot do it all.
